about: retailer_ask.ask as a brand seat (Minimalist, other brands' names hidden) and as the retailer seat, over the frozen Proof views (evals/data/ask_pack.json, python -m evals.snapshot ask). The ten obvious questions per seat plus adversarial ones. Scored against the slices that were sent: validators (numbers, bar labels and values, banned words, hidden names), then the case's own expectation (answered or refused, a chart when comparing, the right product or figure named).
